Subject: Recap + MAP draft (Novafin)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and target close date. Key items in this draft: 

- Target close date: 2026-09-24 (tentative)
- Milestones and owners:
  • PO/Procurement sign-off — Novafin Procurement (Procurement) — target 2026-08-30
  • Security review (SOC 2 evidence + network diagram) — Emma Torres (Novafin) — target 2026-08-20
  • Pilot onboarding (test dataset + runbook) — Marissa Cole / Rishi Malhotra — target 2026-09-07
  • Exec approval (final signoff) — Sarah Liu — target 2026-09-21
- Dependencies: security review completion required before pilot kickoff; procurement PO needed for Dedicated capacity reservation.

Action items for this week: can you confirm the primary procurement contact and whether the security team prefers an NDA before we share the full architecture diagram? I can iterate the MAP once I hear back.
